an8.44:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.44:1.2: atha kho vāseṭṭho upāsako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho vāseṭṭhaṃ upāsakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.44:1.3: aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato vāseṭṭha, uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti …pe…
an8.44:2.1: evaṃ vutte vāseṭṭho upāsako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.44:2.2: piyā me bhante ñātisālohitā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ. piyānampi me assa ñātisālohitānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an8.44:2.3: sabbe cepi bhante, khattiyā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ. sabbesampissa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. sabbe cepi bhante, brāhmaṇā …pe… vessā …pe… suddā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ. sabbesampissa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an8.44:3.2: sabbe cepi vāseṭṭha, khattiyā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ, sabbesampissa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. sabbe cepi vāseṭṭha, brāhmaṇā …pe… vessā …pe… suddā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ, sabbesampissa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an8.44:3.3: sadevako cepi vāseṭṭha, loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā te aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ. sadevakassapissa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an8.44:3.4: ime cepi vāseṭṭha mahāsālā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavaseyyuṃ. imesampissa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
